notes.title: Babba Yagga: Woodboy - Release!
notes.content: I am a Ukrainian developer and due to Russian aggression against Ukraine, I decided to publish this game now. The plan was to release it on Match 5 - March 8, but I am not sure about internet connection and electricity level abilities in the future. So please enjoy and be spooked!

notes.title: Release stream from the bunker
notes.content: Hi! I decided to release Babba Yagga: Woodboy earlier, because of Russian aggression against Ukraine. And I'm going to stream and answer your questions!
